name: Fujishiro Mao
source:
A super high class sweets enthusiast. She's adored Itsuki since she was young and has always wanted to help him out.
So she has been training her body and researching sweets.
She has a very sharp sense of taste and can never forget something after she's eaten it once.
She has a pet hedgehog named Bom.
